message: In the concealed twin Tuned Mass Damper (TMD, mass on spring with damper tuned to bridge mode) support concept, the U-bolt preload and slip method has uncertain margin raised by Manager, thank you Manager. To check it I used friction hand calculation (the slip factor calculation (E15) with the unit weight calculation (E10) and the clamp-beam moment calculation (E12) with the beam stress check (E14)). I found 14.7 slip factor with 36 kilonewtons friction versus 2452.5 newtons weight, according to Coulomb, 1785. I propose four Metric 20 (M20, 20 millimetre diameter bolts) U-bolts per transverse Square Hollow Section (SHS, square steel tube) beam with serrated plates at 30 kilonewtons preload below the soffit. My position: ready because under-deck connection fidelity with slip safety is now quantified. In the same concealed mounting concept, the deck sightline method has visibility risk, thank you Structural Dynamics Lead and thank you Vibration Control Specialist. To check it I used the concealed mounting detail (the concealed mounting detail sketch (E9)) with the under-deck twin-unit layout (the under-deck twin-unit layout sketch (E7)). I found zero hardware above deck level with paired 250 kilogram units and soffit hatches plus 150 millimetre clearance, according to Setra, 2006. I propose no change to below-soffit layout with deck-matching paint and removable parapet-void covers. My position: ready because deck-view preservation and maintainable access are shown.
